Therefore only “Symphonie fantastique” meets the “only‑listed‑performer” criterion.*

### Other conductors who have recorded **Symphonie fantastique** with the Orchestre National de France (or its historical name variants) according to Discogs (as of 1 Jan 2025)

| Conductor | Discogs release title (link) | Historical name of the orchestra (if different) |

**Bottom line**:  
- **The only Berlioz work in Bernstein’s catalog that lists the Orchestre National de France as the sole performer is “Symphonie fantastique, Op. 14.”**  
- **Discogs records four other conductors (James Conlon, Jean Martinon, André Vandernoot, and Charles Munch) who have issued recordings of the same work with the same orchestra (including its historical name variants).**
